categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in architectural design, consulting, research and development, and related extended services. Key segments include conventional architectural design (public buildings, residential buildings, urban and rural planning, landscape design, and decoration design), emerging business design and consulting (prefabricated buildings, green building, energy-saving and low-carbon design), EPC engineering general contracting, construction drawing review, engineering quality testing, and contract energy management. The company also extends into municipal, ecological environmental protection, historical building preservation, and rural construction design.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as Building Information Modeling (BIM), digital twin, AI-assisted design, and smart construction. It emphasizes green building technologies, energy-saving and low-carbon design, prefabricated building technologies, and integrated design-consulting-construction project management. The company also develops proprietary standards and participates in national and provincial standard-setting, focusing on sustainable, energy-efficient, and intelligent building solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, state-owned enterprises, private enterprises, and social organizations primarily within the construction and real estate sectors. Major markets served are public infrastructure, educational, medical, cultural, commercial, residential, and industrial buildings. The company also serves clients involved in urban renewal, green and low-carbon projects, and contract energy management, with a strong presence in provincial and municipal government projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Hefei, Anhui Province, China, and primarily operates within Anhui Province, accounting for over 94% of revenue. It has expanded its market presence to over 20 provinces and municipalities across China, including Jiangsu, Hainan, Chongqing, Hubei, Guangxi, Shandong, and Beijing. It has established subsidiaries and branches in Shanghai, Chongqing, and Bengbu to support regional market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the construction supply chain, providing architectural design, consulting, engineering project management, construction drawing review, and quality testing services. It also extends downstream through EPC general contracting and contract energy management, integrating design with procurement, construction, and energy services, thus covering a broad spectrum of the construction project lifecycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core architectural design capabilities, expanding emerging businesses in green building, prefabricated construction, and low-carbon technologies, and accelerating digital transformation through BIM, AI, and digital twin technologies. The company invests in R&D for sustainable building materials, energy-efficient systems, and smart construction methods. It also focuses on talent development, industry standard formulation, and expanding EPC and full-process consulting services to drive high-quality growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through fees for architectural design and consulting services, EPC project contracting, construction drawing review, engineering quality testing, and contract energy management services. The company earns service fees based on project contracts, including design, procurement, construction management, and energy savings sharing or energy management fees. It also receives income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading architectural design and consulting firm in Anhui Province with a strong reputation and comprehensive qualifications. It competes with large national design firms, international design institutions, and construction companies entering the design market. The industry is highly competitive with increasing concentration among large firms. The company differentiates itself through its integrated service offerings, technical innovation, and strong regional presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 354 million, a 31.15% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 15.57 million, down 73.90%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.41 billion with net assets of RMB 935 million. Despite recent declines due to market contraction and project delays, the company maintains stable operations and continues investing in growth areas and subsidiaries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative architectural design and comprehensive engineering consulting services with a focus on sustainable, green, and intelligent building solutions. It offers integrated design-to-construction lifecycle services including EPC and contract energy management, supported by strong R&D capabilities and a highly qualified professional team. Its differentiation lies in technical expertise, extensive qualifications, regional market leadership, and commitment to digital transformation and environmental sustainability.
